title: OSCAL4Rail Cascade Profile Constraints (additive over NIST OSCAL Profile)
description: Standalone constraint schema for an OSCAL4Rail cascade profile: one level of the Regulatory Cascade expressed as a NIST OSCAL profile that selects controls from an upstream catalog. Checks the railway-specific extension props (cascade-level, parent-catalog-ref, conformance-constraint) in addition to (not instead of) the NIST OSCAL Profile schema. Run as a second validation pass. See docs/reference/cascade-as-profiles.md. Like the catalog constraints schema, this deliberately does NOT $ref the NIST schema (two-pass validation).

o4r-ns.description: The OSCAL4Rail extension namespace. All railway extension props live under this ns so every artifact stays valid NIST OSCAL. See catalog-format.md §5.

cascade-level-enum.description: The cascade levels from the Regulatory Cascade Model (arc42 §1 / docs/reference/cascade-as-profiles.md). Most-significant first.

prop-cascade-level.description: Mandatory on a cascade profile: which level of the cascade this profile represents. Carried in the oscal4rail ns.

prop-parent-catalog-ref.description: Mandatory on a cascade profile: a stable reference to the upstream (parent) catalog this level specializes. Value is a manifest key, URI, or pinned reference resolvable by tooling; the concrete upstream location is carried by the NIST import/@href. Carried in the oscal4rail ns.

prop-conformance-constraint.description: Optional on a cascade profile: the type of conformance relationship to the parent. Conformance flows downward — a child may only specialize, never contradict its parent (ADR-006). The vocabulary mirrors the cascade verbs in arc42 §1. This prop LABELS the relationship declaratively; enforcing it is the job of the validator / Change Impact layer, not this schema.

o4r-prop.description: Conditional checks on the three OSCAL4Rail cascade props. A prop with any other name is not constrained here. When name is one of the cascade props, its ns and value vocabulary are enforced.
